decisions.summary: dependsOn edge adoption from the suggester must be cycle-guarded: bulk-accepting 41 evidence-strong edges created 46 cycles
decisions.why: Suggester evidence (spec mentions, file references) expresses relatedness, which is symmetric; dependsOn is a DAG with direction semantics. Acceptance must add edges greedily in evidence-strength order, rejecting any edge whose reverse path already exists (24 of 41 adopted, 17 rejected as cycle-closing).
decisions.prevention: validate-ontology.js CLI now fails on cycles (previously only the test suite checked acyclicity), so post-edit-ontology-check catches this at write time
